name: Orochi Samurai
headerMeta: Golden era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 295 leadership · Seasonal unit · T5
pitch: A high-DPS skirmisher that punches through armor with minimum damage and disarm effects, but struggles hard when both abilities are on cooldown. Master the 1→2 ability combo to bypass its animation weakness and one-shot heroes.

doctrines.name: Brace Doctrines
doctrines.note: only affect F1/F2/F3 formation brace — Orochi never uses

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Provides consistent results with three quick attacks, high block break, and very high minimum damage; can proc parry.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Snowballs better in blob fights, but slower with minimal block capability and less block break.

battleRole.positioning: Pair with Chaindart or any lock-ult hero {1}. Avoid blob fights unless ability 1 is available — when both are on cooldown, disengage if enemy has stun/daze {1}. In engagements, position to catch isolated targets for hero one-shots {1}.
battleRole.tips: Ability 1 (Piercing Strike) phases through enemy units regardless of type — use it before ability 2 to maximize DPS inside the enemy {1}. The 1→2 combo: use ability 1, then just before the second strike, trigger ability 2 — this applies CC for the remainder of ability 1's duration and ensures damage goes through even if knocked/dazed {1}. Ability 2 (Storm Pound) has short range; if dazed or CC'd at activation, the animation may not occur {1}. Both abilities disarm, but ability 1 does not cleanse existing CC {1}.

cards.name: Block units
cards.why: Orochi lacks block and struggles vs high block enemies

cards.name: High DR/armor units
cards.why: High minimum damage on both abilities makes Orochi a counter with Spartan, Reapers

controls.notes: Ability 1 (Piercing Strike): phases through enemy units, deals high damage to charging units. {1} Ability 2 (Storm Pound): high minimum damage, blocks, procs parry, block regenerates quickly like Zweihander's ability 2. {1} Disarm effect: all abilities prevent enemy attacks for a duration; mid-animation disarm only blocks next animation. {1} 1→2 combo: overcomes ability 2's weakness by ensuring animation occurs and damage applies. {1}
